_comment: Shared integrity-signal fixture. Kinds are the allow-list contract: the DB enum (prisma/schema.prisma IntegrityEventKind), the TS types (lib/monitor-patch.ts EXHAUSTIVE_KINDS / INTEGRITY_KIND_LABELS, derived from the Prisma enum), the Go gate (ws-backend/internal/protocol/messages.go IntegrityEventKinds) and the monitor labels must all cover exactly these. patchKeys are the only keys the monitor patch merge (lib/monitor-patch.ts mergeKnownPatchKeys) may accept — the true set as published by ws-backend (room.go broadcastMonitorUpdate call sites and main.go's BEK attestation notify) plus deviceReplacedCount from the takeover patch Next.js publishes in lib/exam-device.ts; sebIntegrityStatus was a candidate but the real producer emits sebIntegrityFlagged/sebIntegrityReason.
